column2: No man of the soft races can give a Meargh daughters, and the clan cannot wait for my womb to grow cold. The elders of the clan have gathered in the mist to bring me a mate of our own blood: a Fimm warrior, a noble of the Fimm or one of the Dirach who speak with the things beyond the veil. The nobles and the Dirach are proud, and only a Meargh of great renown can bind them to her.

The marriage has come to nothing. Only the Meargh among our kind can bear young, and she is not for me. But the villages of Men are close, and the mist hides much. A woman of Men carried off from her hearth will give my line its sons, as it has always been among the Fimir.
Send the raiders into the mist. Bring me a bride.
The strongest of my Fimm warriors will do.
My deeds are enough to bind a noble of the Fimm.
My power and devotion will bind a Dirach to me.
